authority: Connect2Media J2ME target not yet traced; MSX2 source comparison and later-canon boundaries
mission_progression: One-based labels. Missions are story arcs inside one connected Outer Heaven; prior rooms are revisited with persistent world state. No false claim that 4–8 are playable.
mapping_note: Mission boundaries are proposed remake pacing divisions, not official original 1987 mission numbering

missions.title: Operation Intrude N313
missions.return_purpose: Facility establishes landmarks that acquire new meaning after Fox's rescue and Ellen's discovery
missions.signature_character_scene: 3F POW shares detention-transfer evidence and Diane frequency; never automatic mission success
revisit_changes: Card 1 and collected supplies remain acquired
missions.next_transition: Player intentionally initiates the detention transfer

story_threads.opening: Rookie accepts credible instruction from senior commander
story_threads.turn: First independent gear and prisoner discoveries supplement the orders
story_threads.payoff: Snake can compare what his commander says with people he has physically rescued

story_threads.opening: Gray Fox is an admired missing professional, not yet a face-to-face ally
story_threads.turn: Prisoners indicate the operative is alive but inaccessible
story_threads.payoff: Snake chooses to expose himself to capture rather than abandon the search

story_threads.opening: Resistance voices cannot automatically command Snake's trust
story_threads.turn: Schneider's structural knowledge can be checked; a freed POW gives Diane's frequency
story_threads.payoff: Player earns optional, differentiated radio allies through exploration

missions.title: The Missing Fox
world: Building One secret prison prototype; basement position provisional
missions.return_purpose: First prison walls establish language later used for Ellen's concealed cell
missions.signature_character_scene: Gray Fox's nuclear warning is committed at rescue interaction, not at end of dialogue playback
revisit_changes: original ammo and rations carry through
missions.next_transition: After actual escape and gear reclaim, return to Building One

story_threads.opening: Rookie is vulnerable as the captured veteran was
story_threads.turn: Snake physically breaches the cell and meets a capable but exhausted Fox
story_threads.payoff: Fox entrusts nuclear-warning and scientist lead; Snake carries his knowledge forward

story_threads.opening: Commander remains an apparently helpful professional during crisis
story_threads.turn: Correct suggestions build apparent credibility, though not supernatural insight
story_threads.payoff: Later false orders will hurt because these earlier instructions proved useful

story_threads.opening: Prison removes Snake's agency and equipment
story_threads.turn: Physical wall breaches and locker recovery restore it
story_threads.payoff: Escape means surviving actual sentries with recovered resources, not just finishing a conversation

missions.title: The Scientist Trail
world: Building One revisit, roof and exterior checkpoint; latter unimplemented
missions.return_purpose: Areas first explored for gear now support independent searching and source-based backtracking
missions.signature_character_scene: On returning to Building One, the mission status reflects Fox's warning and the resistance calls change
revisit_changes: all previously opened doors and pickups persist
guard occupancy can later react to an escape
missions.next_transition: Building Two route is not yet implemented

story_threads.opening: Fox is no longer present but his report is durable
story_threads.turn: Snake tests the report against scientist leads and guarded research routes
story_threads.payoff: The next objective arises from Fox's truth rather than an omniscient waypoint

story_threads.opening: Schneider was correct about altered walls but lacked prison plans
story_threads.turn: He admits gaps in his drawings and points Snake toward actual infrastructure
story_threads.payoff: Snake respects advice without surrendering his own observations

story_threads.opening: Diane knows defenders; Big Boss still offers sometimes useful operational advice
story_threads.turn: Specialist enemy counterplay makes each voice distinct
story_threads.payoff: Different kinds of knowledge, rather than a universal hint voice

missions.title: The Outer Defences
world: Roadway, Building Two approach, research defences
missions.return_purpose: Architectural knowledge, tactical aid and persistent prisoner rescues unlock an occupied research complex
missions.signature_character_scene: Jennifer's aid has a physical delivery/access consequence; not an inventory teleport or purely optional radio

story_threads.opening: Medical insider has an independent reason to conceal her identity
story_threads.turn: Rescue-earned access supports the critical weapon/door assistance
story_threads.payoff: Jennifer proves trustworthy through a real delivered tool at personal risk

story_threads.opening: Reports of specialists on secured routes
story_threads.turn: Diane's actionable advice helps interpret suppression and fire patterns
story_threads.payoff: Successful counterplay makes the resistance relationship credible

story_threads.opening: The engineer exists only as Fox's lead
story_threads.turn: False directions and TX-11 machines establish the lengths to which Outer Heaven goes to conceal him
story_threads.payoff: Finding the true engineer becomes a personal investigation

missions.title: The Price of Metal Gear
world: Building Two Madnar cell → Building One hidden basement → Building Two return
missions.return_purpose: The earlier prison becomes the site of Ellen's rescue; player reinterprets confinement architecture
missions.signature_character_scene: Ellen found in Building One basement, then Snake physically returns to Madnar in Building Two
revisit_changes: newly breached basement wall remains open
Madnar dialogue and technical intel update
no arbitrary resets to earlier rooms

story_threads.opening: The coerced scientist refuses technical information until his daughter is safe
story_threads.turn: Snake chooses to return through danger to rescue Ellen
story_threads.payoff: Madnar's trust yields a specific TX-55 destruction method

story_threads.opening: Separated father and daughter are two people, not a single quest key
story_threads.turn: Ellen is found beyond a hidden wall and speaks for herself
story_threads.payoff: Her confirmed safety changes Madnar's behaviour; no invented on-screen reunion

story_threads.opening: Snake follows the lead Fox risked his freedom to convey
story_threads.turn: Coercion explains the machine's origin
story_threads.payoff: Fox's warning is vindicated and connected to a real human cost

missions.title: The Cost of Loyalty
world: Desert return, Building Three, Coward Duck hostages
missions.return_purpose: Earlier advice becomes suspect, and a personal rescue becomes crucial escape knowledge
missions.signature_character_scene: Hostage-safe Coward Duck victory carries Jennifer's family story into the ending
revisit_changes: rescued brother and hostages remain safe
trapped routes reflect Big Boss's misinformation
missions.next_transition: Search deep bunker for the real commander

story_threads.opening: The commander previously provided true and false-access-resistant advice
story_threads.turn: Specific truck and door instructions become unsafe; the player can check reality
story_threads.payoff: Skepticism has mechanical value before the formal betrayal reveal

story_threads.opening: Undercover ally finally reveals the family member she is risking everything to save
story_threads.turn: Coward Duck shields himself with hostages; precision and restraint matter
story_threads.payoff: Rescued brother gives a left-ladder escape clue that matters during the final evacuation

story_threads.opening: Architect's knowledge has repeatedly helped
story_threads.turn: He tries to disclose the fortress leader before his line is cut off
story_threads.payoff: Silence generates fear and uncertainty, but not a fabricated confirmed death

missions.title: Orders and Evidence
world: Building Three deep basement, prisoner witness, final security
missions.return_purpose: A person previously rescued supplies proof that changes how command radio is understood
missions.signature_character_scene: Big Boss's command to stop follows witness evidence, not a premature cinematic spoiler
revisit_changes: previous trust cues reframe as possible deception

story_threads.opening: Snake has growing empirical doubts about his mentor
story_threads.turn: A prisoner identifies Big Boss as the mastermind; the voice orders Snake to abort
story_threads.payoff: Snake acts on corroborated evidence over institutional authority

story_threads.opening: Resistance voices previously earned trust
story_threads.turn: They provide limited practical knowledge without claiming omniscience
story_threads.payoff: The player enters the core with independent allies and earned abilities

missions.title: Outer Heaven
world: TX-55 chamber, commander's final room, escape shafts, exterior
missions.return_purpose: All earlier choices and relationships pay off under self-destruct pressure
missions.signature_character_scene: TX-55 destruction precedes final commander fight, then physical escape under countdown
revisit_changes: mission-ending survival flags and original closing message remain durable
missions.next_transition: 1995 mission complete; later-series context not inserted

story_threads.opening: Fox exposed the threat; Madnar provided the precise means of stopping it
story_threads.turn: Snake destroys TX-55 by executing the earned demolition sequence
story_threads.payoff: Earlier prisoner and family rescues give the finale a clear cause and effect

story_threads.opening: The radio mentor and apparent fortress commander converge in Snake's perception
story_threads.turn: Final confrontation occurs only after destruction starts the self-destruct sequence
story_threads.payoff: Snake rejects compromised command; later Venom identity remains unknowable to 1995 Snake

story_threads.opening: Rescued brother's left-ladder advice and the resistance's care remain alive
story_threads.turn: Player remembers the correct escape route while Diane admits uncertainty
story_threads.payoff: Survival is a consequence of helping people, not an arbitrary cutscene

prisoner_visibility_contract: Mission 02 secret prison: four visible including Snake and Fox, plus two noncanonical ambient visual-only detainees in adjacent barred wing
